response.sql: WITH group_averages AS (SELECT s.zoneref, t.typesite, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_compression_ratio, AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_size_per_minute FROM scans AS s JOIN sites AS t ON t.zoneregistry = s.zoneref WHERE s.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, t.typesite) SELECT AVG(avg_compression_ratio) AS average_compression_ratio, AVG(avg_size_per_minute) AS average_size_per_minute FROM group_averages;

assumptions.assumption: A zero scan duration has an undefined size-per-minute value and is excluded from that average.
